pages.title: Celestial Infusion
pages.text: Celestial Infusion is a focused ritual process that channels energy from nearby Celestial Blooms through a Ritual Brazier. It offers a direct and immediate way to transform items using natural celestial forces.

pages.title: Requirements
pages.text: Celestial Infusion requires a $(l:hexalia:blocks/ritual_brazier)Ritual Brazier$(/l) with open sky above it, along with at least three $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#celestial_bloom)Celestial Blooms$(/l) placed within a short radius.

pages.title: Process
pages.text: Place the desired ingredient into the brazier, then activate it using a Hex Focus. If the surrounding conditions are met, the infusion begins immediately, drawing energy from the nearby blooms.

pages.title: Transformation
pages.text: During infusion, celestial energy is consumed from the blooms. They wither over time, eventually turning into dead remnants, while the inserted item is transformed within the brazier.

pages.title: On Use
pages.text: Celestial Infusion provides a simpler alternative to more complex rituals, allowing quick transformations at the cost of natural resources gathered from the world.
